_readme: cSurvey APP settings (per Windows user, per computer) that the 3N kit primes into HKCU\Software\Cepelabs\cSurvey. FILE settings (centerline colour, sign sizes...) live in tdx-mapping.json `postimport` instead. Which kind a setting is, and how to add one: stages/3N-nacrt/production/csurvey-settings.md. Value type decides the registry type: a JSON string -> REG_SZ (decimals with a dot, as cSurvey writes them), a JSON integer -> REG_DWORD.

pens.smooth.why: Freehand pen strokes keep their detail; cSurvey's floor is 0.01 (user decision 2026-10-03).

tools.smooth.why: Same factor for the reduce-points action on a selected item (user decision 2026-10-03).
